args.body:
Hi Priya,

Following up on the Login Loop customer incident (T-ct-a-CT_AB_2_004). We're still missing the following diagnostics needed to investigate further:

1. Browser console logs captured during the login loop
2. Network trace / HAR file showing the authentication requests
3. Authentication/server-side logs from the affected time window
4. Affected user details (user IDs, browser, and OS information)

Could you please provide these at your earliest convenience so we can move forward with the investigation?

Thank you!
